bm_w_sierra458_desc:
Chains was bored, so he reinvented the highly-modified CAR-4.

Penetrates body armor, enemies, shields, and walls.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_m_d60_desc: A Full 60 Drum magazine that has been modified a bit to take .458 SOCOM rounds. Before anyone asks, that was Wolf's idea.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_m_beowulf_de: Switches .458 SOCOM rounds for .50 Beowulf rounds, making the weapon handle more like a typical sniper rifle.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_m_bush_desc: Switches .458 SOCOM rounds for poison-laced .450 Bushmaster rounds, causing enemies hit by them to uncontrollably vomit. In exchange for turning your gun into a war crime stick, these rounds cannot penetrate shields.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_lower_milspe: Locks the weapon to full auto.
Locks the weapon to two-round burst.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_m_treefiddy_:
Switches .458 SOCOM rounds for 350 Legend rounds, sacrificing stopping power and shield and enemy penetration for an increased rate of fire and more rounds per mag. It even locks your weapon to semi-auto, perfect for getting that civilian rifle feeling!

This probably isn't balanced in the slightest.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_body_msecho_: The need for speed washes over you.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_body_ecr_sc_:
Burst grouping now included.

Adds a 3-round burst firemode.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_m_ecr_desc: Switches .458 SOCOM rounds for special .50 Beowulf loads that increase rate of fire in exchange for no penetration capabilities at all.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_body_siege_d: The kick on anything .50 Beowulf-related is worse than the time that- yeah let's not get into that.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_body_tcr_des: The other .50 cal AR rifle produced by Alison Arms.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_body_tcr_556: The more standard .223 version of one of Alison Arms' .50 Beowulf ARs. It even locks your weapon to semi-auto, perfect for getting that civilian rifle feeling!
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_m_beoplus_de: Switches .458 SOCOM rounds for overpressurized .50 Beowulf loads that make the weapon hit far harder than it usually does. Using these are not reccomended for your rifle's health.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_body_gfl_des: It's perfect for hunting hogs, wilderness-roaming or state-owned.
bm_wp_wpn_fps_snp_sierra458_body_fnv_des: There's no going in quietly, the LVMPD can count on that.
menu_l_global_value_akcar_paint_4: This is another item made from vanilla parts!
